run_inference_on_image: run inference on a single image using detectron models and output a visualization PDF
get_rpn_box_proposals: get region proposal network box proposals and scores from an input image
parse_inference_args: parse command line arguments for image inference including model pkl and config yaml pairs
check_inference_args: validate and cache inference arguments ensuring rpn pkl and cfg files exist
run_multi_model_inference: run multiple detectron models in sequence on an image to predict boxes, masks, keypoints, and body meshes
